The _maximum_margin_relevance selection algorithm is adapted in
retrieval_engine/evidence_selection.py. Modifications: use existing cross-encoder relevance
scores and cached embeddings; add deterministic same-source text deduplication,
optional caller-supplied source coverage, a soft source repetition penalty,
configurable relevance margin/floor, and lexical redundancy fallback. No model
downloads or provider calls are performed by this adapted module.
